incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: 12 nodes in k8s cluster infer-pool-usw-2 toggled NotReady within 3m. Root cause suspected: kubelet restarts. Pager: @oncall-sam

oncall-sam: sam: taking this — acked the page. oncall switching to incident channel.

infra-lee: lee: quick triage: nodes show kubelet process restart loops. dmesg on node-7: 'kernel: kubelet invoked oom-killer' and NV driver logs show multiple NVRM Xid entries. could be GPU driver hang triggering kubelet restart.

runtime-maya: maya: runtime pods on those nodes show frequent exit code 137 / CrashLoopBackOff. logs show repeated "failed to allocate device memory" before container restart. snippets below:

```
E0321 14:09:12.345678 1 runtime.go:123] allocation failed: CUDA error: out of memory
I0321 14:09:12.346000 1 main.go:421] exiting with code 137
```

sre-jordan: jordan: corroborating. kubelet logs show: `kubelet: runtime manager failed to handle event: container runtime error: unable to start container: failed prestart hooks` then kubelet restarts. Also seeing node kernel OOM events around the same time.

oncall-sam: sam: initial mitigation plan — cordon affected nodes, drain noncritical inference pods, scale up fallback capacity (dedicated-reserve-1) +3, and flip routing to quantized-model-serve in the region for latency-sensitive customers.

prod-ops-eli: eli: starting scale now — bumping dedicated-reserve-1 replica count from 6 -> 9. will also warm KV caches on new instances.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: autoscaler request submitted (id: asr-9034). estimated ready in ~2m.

infra-lee: lee: cordoning nodes node-3 node-7 node-11 now.

```
# commands run by infra
kubectl cordon node-3 node-7 node-11
kubectl drain node-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep CrashLoopBackOff
```

runtime-maya: maya: enabling fallback routing rule in routing service: set route /generate -> quantized-model-v2 weight 100 for infer-pool-usw-2. will also enable short-circuit retries with longer backoff to avoid thundering herd.

cust-success-ana: ana: heads-up to CS — customers Lumina and AcmeCorp show increased 500s and slower responses. sending a brief to their SREs and support channels now.

oncall-sam: sam: monitoring error rates. creating temporary alert to escalate if 5xx persists beyond 10m.

sre-jordan: jordan: small forensic note: some nodes show `NVRM: Xid 79` and GPU hangs preceeding kubelet reboot. pattern: large inference batch requests + memory pressure -> driver hang -> kernel OOM -> kubelet restart. we're currently treating this as cascading resource exhaustion rather than pure k8s bug.

infra-lee: lee: collecting kernel + nv driver versions. node-3: kernel 5.15.92, nvidia-driver 525.60.13. opening ticket with infra-image team to validate driver/firmware combo.

prod-ops-eli: eli: new dedicated replicas are ready and registered, routing flipped. 500s for most customers dropping.

oncall-sam: sam: good. continuing to watch. pulling crashloop pods logs and creating a short incident summary for postmortem.

runtime-maya: maya: added a temporary admission hook to cap single-request GPU memory to 75% for the infer container (quick guardrail) — PR link: https://git.internal/r/infer/guardrails/pull/512 (will revert after root cause fixed).

cust-success-ana: ana: Lumina acknowledged fallback and said they see improved latency ~30s after routing change. AcmeCorp still has intermittent errors, routing to dedicated-reserve-1 should help — continuing comms.

sre-jordan: jordan: recommendation for follow-up: 1) set node-level min-reserve for GPU memory in kubelet config, 2) pin nvidia-driver to validated build across infer pools, 3) add autoscaler rule to keep min nodes x for critical pools, 4) add targeted retry/backoff on router for GPU OOMs.

infra-lee: lee: filing image validation task and scheduling a kernel+driver upgrade window with low-traffic window next week.

oncall-sam: sam: marking incident as mitigated for now — traffic routed to warm capacity and error rates back to baseline. leaving nodes cordoned until further investigation complete. will open a full postmortem and assign owners for the four remediation items jordan listed.

incident-bot: :page_with_curl: Incident created: INC-2026-1043. severity: Sev2. mitigated: true. responders: @oncall-sam @infra-lee @runtime-maya @sre-jordan @prod-ops-eli @cust-success-ana

prod-ops-eli: eli: quick ops note — we saw a spike in prefetch cache misses when switching to quantized model; added a warm-up job to pre-seed caches for 5m.

runtime-maya: maya: will draft runbook updates and add the guardrail change to a canary workflow.

cust-success-ana: ana: sending final customer note with timelines and mitigation summary.

sre-jordan: jordan: I'll own the postmortem. creating skeleton now and will assign action items.

oncall-sam: sam: thanks team. keeping channel open for any late flaps.

incident-bot: :lock: Incident channel will remain archived until postmortem link posted.
